summary: Kimi Antonelli arrives at Austin on the cusp of history, with pole position in hand and the chance to become Formula 1's youngest world champion Sunday—a crown within reach if Mercedes' prodigy executes flawlessly against a resurgent Charles Leclerc and Ferrari's Friday pace. The Italian's composure under unprecedented pressure contrasts sharply with Leclerc's momentum, setting up a title-deciding duel between youth and experience on the Circuit of the Americas' high-speed straights. A victory for Antonelli would rewrite the championship record books; any stumble hands Ferrari a lifeline and drags the title fight toward the final rounds.
